params.1273: Given by Aleck in Yanille for completing all Hard Tasks in Ardougne.
params.1292: Ardougne cloak 3 and a magic lamp worth 28,000xp in a skill of your choice. Wizard Cromperty will offer you 150 noted essence per day.
params.1274: The cloak gains the following extra benefits:
params.1275: - Improved rate of success when picking pockets or shoplifting from stalls anywhere in RuneScape.
params.1276: - Teleport traps on chests will always teleport you to Ardougne's north bank.
params.1277: - 80% of items dropped in the Tower of Life will be noted.
params.1278: Talk to Aleck in Yanille to toggle your Watchtower Teleport destination to Yanille town centre.
